svg.title: A choice with Option A picked, a copy box on its bash tab with a Copy button, and a three-step checklist with Done, Failed and Skip pills

g.text: A choice you answer with one click, a copy box with a tab per shell and a Copy button, and a
checklist whose Done / Failed / Skip pills reach Claude with your next message.
